title: What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base
paragraphs: A major blaze swept through a Canadian military base on Saturday, killing at least four people and leaving 19 people in critical condition.
Witnesses described the sight of dozens of people being rushed to hospital, mixed with the sound of soldiers yelling in agony, as being "like a scene from a war movie".
Prime Minister Mark Carney called it one of the worst peace-time tragedies on Canadian soil in the history of the military.
